oracle.scope: 17.a.W implements complete immutable Base/Ours/Theirs source observations through native local, Git, Baseline and verified full-bundle readers. Complete original resource bytes, project/schema identity, default closed project scope, native model roots and source provenance are retained. No versioned merge plan, conflict resolution, CLI/Work integration or write authority is implemented by this slice. 17.a.R rejects partial/selected sources and mixed project/schema inputs without migration, preserves historical effective profile selection and qualified legacy bytes, checks pinned Git extraction proofs, and reobserves all three source acquisitions before returning. Observations remain non-atomic. 17.a.C moves the full-source registry into snapshots while preserving the public merge facade, native adapters, all W/R behavior tests and errors.
